test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Rajdhani Express and Garib Rath Express run in the same direction with speeds of 115 km/hr and 61 km/hr, respectively, and their lengths are the same. What is the length of the Rajdhani Express if it completely crosses the Garib Rath Express in 116 seconds?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (same direction) = 115 − 61 = 54 km/hr

Total distance to cross = Sum of lengths = 2L

Convert speed: 54 km/hr = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s

Distance = Speed × Time ⇒ 2L = 15 × 116 = 1740

**∴ Answer = L = 870 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Rajdhani = 115 km/hr

Speed of Garib Rath = 61 km/hr

Time = 116 sec

Lengths are equal = L

**Formula used:**

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed (same direction) = 115 − 61 = 54 km/hr

⇒ Convert into m/s = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s

⇒ Total distance covered = Sum of lengths = L + L = 2L

⇒ 2L = 15 × 116

⇒ 2L = 1740

⇒ L = 1740 ÷ 2 = 870 m

**∴ The correct answer is 870 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

Relative speed = Difference of speeds = v1 − v2

Train Crossing Rule

When two trains cross, total distance = Sum of lengths

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s multiply by 5/18

General Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed
